text_block_list.text:
I decide to drop by a cafe to quench my
thirst.
The cafe is packed, but I finally
make it to the
front of the line to enter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ding-a-ling! ♪ Welcome! ☆ Thank you
for
waiting! Table for one?
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This place is super cute and
fancy! I'm
gonna stick out like a sore
thumb!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Really? You appear to be fitting in
perfectly well
to me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, but we don't have any
empty
tables at the moment...
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you mind sharing your table
with
these two patrons?
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're a trainer from the academy!
Are you
sure? We'd really appreciate it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Well then, allow us to accept your
kindness and
join you.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! ☆ I'll show you to
your
table! ♪
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
We sit at our table and look through the
menu. As
we're about to order...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um... For my drink, I'll have a, uh...
Royal... Mari...
Maririn? Please.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Certainly! ♪ One Royal ☆ Maririn!
Would you like
an Angel Ring to go with
that? It's on our
seasonal dessert menu!
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh, uh, yeah... One of those too.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! ♪ Oh! You have a choice of
three
sizes for your drink—Dolly, Pretty,
or Charming!
Which would you like? ☆
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text: P-pretty? Charming? Um, uhhh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Pardon us... This is our first time here.
Might I
trouble you to explain the sizes?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Certainly! ☆ "Dolly" is a small, "Pretty" is
a
medium, and...
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
After listening to the staff go through
the unique
size names, we somehow
manage to order three
drinks and a
dessert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haha... Half of what she said was
gibberish to
me...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Phewww. I can finally relax. I was on
edge that
whole time...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Your composure really saved my glutes,
Ardan.
Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I should be the one thanking you
for the
invitation. You've given me the
opportunity to
experience this whimsical
cafe.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Yes, we've been meeting regularly at
Mejiro
family gatherings ever since we
were young. Ryan
has always been so
kindhearted.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
She would always teach me new games
or show
me secret spots. I have many fun
and fond
Воспоминания с her.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I almost forgot about that!
You're older
than me, so I loved how
you'd always listen to
what I had to say.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and I still really appreciate that
about you,
even now!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but of course. I'll gladly lend you
an ear
whenever you may need it.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Ding-a-ling! ♪ Thank you for waiting!
Here are
your Royal ☆ Maririns aaand
your Angel Ring!
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text: So this is a Royal Maririn... It's black tea.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And this Angel Ring... appears to be a
very large
Baumkuchen.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
It's as big as a whole cake! Looks like a
lot to
eat...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: You two can finish it if you share it!
How about getting it to go?

text_block_list.text:
It's as big as a whole cake! Looks like a
lot to
eat...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: You two can finish it if you share it!
How about getting it to go?

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let's cut it and have half each,
Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan makes a silent, elegant cut
through
the Baumkuchen.
Unfortunately...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, I seem to have split it
unevenly. You
can have the large
portion, Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
No, you cut it for me, so you should eat
the
bigger piece!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you needn't be shy. Besides, I'd
like to be
the mature and responsible
Umamusume today.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know. Perhaps I should cut it into
smaller
pieces to make it easier to eat.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, thanks! Ack, I dunno why, but
my face is
burning up!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's try some of this tea! It
looks really
tasty!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh my... The fragrance is so pure. These
must be
single-estate tea leaves.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
You can tell that from the smell? You
and Dober
know so much when it comes
to tea... Talk about
well-educated.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Our knowledge comes from our love of
it. You
have much more knowledge than
I do when it
comes to muscles, don't
you?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
That's true... Oh! I know this one muscle
workout
you can do right now, while
you're sitting down!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's called a "seated calf raise." You
focus on
putting weight on your soleus
muscle and...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: My goodness... Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
They happily split the Baumkuchen and
finish the
whole thing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We enjoy a spirited chat about various
topics as
we sip and savor our tea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
